---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new mode, operation or audit
labels: enhancement
---

**What you want to clean up**

The situation in your instance, not the implementation.

**Which part of the tool it touches**

- [ ] a new write operation (needs `ORDER`, `cmd_apply`, `actions.md`)
- [ ] a new audit (reads the index, writes nothing)
- [ ] a new mode (a reference file plus a router row)
- [ ] prompt or wording only
- [ ] not sure

**Anything that makes it irreversible?**

If the idea involves deleting or merging, say what would be lost and how a
user would check the result.
